layoutReset: Put the reward cards back in their default places?

api.label: Rewards API
api.hint: the key is the same as in “Events”, in the Authorization: Bearer header

picker.title: Rewards
picker.hint: Ticked — viewers see the reward and can buy it

points.title: Channel stream points
points.renameText: New name for stream points (2–24 characters). It can be changed once every 30 days.
points.renameHint: The name can be changed once every 30 days
points.rule: Viewers get them every {min} min of watching: +{f} for followers, +{v} for others (they have to click the bonus).

kind.highlight: Starter: the viewer's message is highlighted in chat and in the OBS overlay.
kind.coinflip: Starter: the bot flips a coin and posts the result in chat.
kind.hello: Starter: the viewer's text shows up in OBS (the “Reward” event).

limit: You can have up to {n} rewards

edit.title: Edit reward
edit.name: Title
edit.replyHint: (optional — the bot posts it after a purchase)

vars.target: first word of the text (a nickname)
vars.title: stream title
vars.count: how many times the reward was bought
vars.count_user: how many times this viewer bought it

funcs.widget: number or text of an OBS widget

limits.title: ⏳ Limits
limits.hint: Empty or 0 — no limit. Your own tests (buying from the channel account) ignore the limits.

action.title: 🎛 OBS widget action
action.hint: After a purchase the reward changes the widget by itself: adds time to a timer, +1 to a counter, shows the viewer text, spins a wheel. The value supports the same {variables} as the bot reply.
action.noWidgets: No widgets yet — create them in the studio, “⏱️ Widgets”.
